note: Long-acting GH analogues: somatrogon approved 2023 for pediatric GHD after rat data, somavaratan failed phase 3 against daily GH in 2017, somatropin pegol (NNC126-0083) stopped after phase 1 with no admissible model source.
label: Hypopituitarism (GHR agonists)

engagement.note: Somatrogon (CTP-GH-CTP-CTP) every 4-5 days raised cumulative serum IGF-1 above daily hGH in hypophysectomized rats.
engagement.quote: In addition, the cumulative serum levels of IGF-I after injection of GH-LA was significantly higher than that detected after injection of Biotropin.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry for the rat track: the member drug (GH-LA = somatrogon/MOD-4023) in the model, no patient data yet.

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PubMed); the PD readout is read as IGF-1, the readout of the human study it seeded.
engagement.note: Somavaratan monthly 1.4 mg/kg held the IGF-1 response in juvenile monkeys for a month.
engagement.quote: In juvenile monkeys, a monthly dose of 1.4 mg/kg VRS-317 (equivalent to 0.26 mg/kg rhGH) caused a sustained pharmacodynamic response for 1 month equivalent to 0.05 mg/kg/day rhGH
engagement.judgement: Opening entry for the monkey track (member drug VRS-317 = somavaratan).

engagement.magnitude_basis: IGF-1 rise after a single dose
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract plus PMC full text (dose-selection paragraph cites the monkey potency).
engagement.note: Single somavaratan doses raised IGF-1 dose-dependently in GH-deficient adults; 0.8 mg/kg kept it in range about 3 weeks.
engagement.quote: Single VRS-317 doses of 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.40, and 0.80 mg/kg (approximately equivalent to daily rhGH doses of 0.3-5.0 μg/kg over 30 d) safely increased the amplitude and duration of IGF-I responses in a dose-dependent manner.
engagement.judgement: Paired by me: Yuen cites the monkey potency to pick the first human dose (a citation, so comparison_stated false). IGF-1 is read as downstream of GHR signalling.

engagement.confidence_note: PMC full text read. Registry NCT02968004 results posted 2021-06-25 (IGF-1 content of the posting not checked), so the comparison may date to 2021.
engagement.note: Weekly somatrogon raised IGF-1 SDS from -1.95 to 0.65 at 12 months, above daily somatropin (-0.69), as the rat predicted.
engagement.quote: In the somatrogon group, the mean value for IGF-1 SDS was −1.95 at baseline, approached 0 at 1 month post-baseline, and was 0.65 SDS (range: −3.64 to 3.22) at 12 months post-baseline
engagement.reason: IGF-1 higher than daily GH, as rats
engagement.judgement: Paired by me (Deal does not cite the rat data). Rats showed cumulative IGF-1 above daily hGH; children showed higher mean IGF-1 SDS than daily somatropin at 12 months, so same in direction.

engagement.note: Somatrogon every 5 days gave exposure comparable to daily rhGH and raised IGF-1 in rats and rhesus monkeys.
engagement.quote: Repeated administration of MOD-4023 led to elevated levels of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), and twice-weekly injections of MOD-4023 resulted in larger increase in weight gain with fewer injections and a lower accumulative hGH dose.
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract only (paywalled Mol Pharm); opening entry at publication (epub 2016-01-18), though the studies preceded first-in-human dosing (NCT01060722, started 2009-10).
engagement.judgement: Monkey kept as its own track: the draft's hypox-rat track is somatrogon's rat system; the monkey is a separate species with its own IGF-1 readout.
engagement.model: Rhesus monkey PK/PD and repeat-dose toxicology (somatrogon)

engagement.note: Weekly somatrogon raised IGF-1 dose-dependently in GH-deficient adults and held IGF-1 SDS in the normal range, as in monkeys.
engagement.short: GHD adults IGF-1 up, as monkey
engagement.quote: Dose-dependent response was observed for both PK and PD data of weekly MOD-4023 treatment. Insulin-like growth factor I (IGF-I) SDS levels were maintained within normal range.
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract read (PMC5292974 available, full text not read). Adult phase 2 NCT01225666 has no posted results; epub 2016-12-08.
engagement.reason: IGF-1 rose in GHD adults, as monkeys
engagement.judgement: Paired by me: Strasburger does not set the monkey data beside patients in the abstract. Monkey predicted IGF-1 rise on infrequent dosing; adults showed it on weekly dosing, so same in direction.
engagement.model: Rhesus monkey PK/PD and repeat-dose toxicology (somatrogon)

dose.note: Rat doses were compared with daily hGH by total mg/kg; no human dose, exposure or margin was stated.
dose.quote: Treatment with CTP-GH-CTP-CTP (GH-LA) or CTP-GH-CTP (0.6 mg/kg) once every 5 d for 11 d or with Biotropin (0.12 mg/kg) daily for 11 d (total dose 1.2 mg/kg) resulted in a dramatic increase in weight gain
dose.judgement: Somatrogon's human dose (0.66 mg/kg/week) was set clinically; the rat paper gives no translatable target.

dose.note: Monkeys gave a dose equivalence: 1.4 mg/kg monthly somavaratan matched 0.05 mg/kg/day rhGH (fivefold potency).
dose.quote: In juvenile monkeys, a monthly dose of 1.4 mg/kg VRS-317 (equivalent to 0.26 mg/kg rhGH) caused a sustained pharmacodynamic response for 1 month equivalent to 0.05 mg/kg/day rhGH
dose.judgement: This potency ratio is the model's stated regimen target.

dose.magnitude_basis: dose sustaining IGF-1 for about a month (0.8 mg/kg/3 wk human vs 1.4 mg/kg/month monkey)
dose.note: In GHD adults 0.8 mg/kg kept IGF-1 in range ~3 weeks, close to the monkey's 1.4 mg/kg per month.
dose.short: Adult IGF-1 target reached near monkey dose
dose.quote: After a single 0.80 mg/kg dose, serum IGF-I was maintained in the normal range between -1.5 and 1.5 SD values for a mean of 3 weeks.
dose.judgement: Paired by me. Adults need less GH per kg than the juvenile monkeys modelled, so the adult match is within 2x but not a test of the pediatric equivalence.

dose.confidence_note: Sponsor press release (tier 5); the registry record NCT02339090 (results posted 2022-12-30) confirms: LS mean difference -1.28 cm/y, 95% CI -2.32 to -0.24 against a -2.0 margin.
dose.note: VELOCITY: 3.5 mg/kg twice monthly (5x the monkey-equivalent dose) still grew children less than daily rhGH 34 µg/kg (9.43 vs 10.70 cm/y).
dose.short: 5x monkey dose still below daily GH
dose.quote: Non-inferiority versus daily growth hormone was not demonstrated in the intent to treat (ITT) population for the primary efficacy variable
dose.judgement: Judgement call: the monkey stated a dose equivalence (1.4 mg/kg/month = 0.05 mg/kg/day rhGH). Children received 7 mg/kg/month and stayed below 1.0 mg/kg/month rhGH, so the potency ratio was off >5x; scored as dose contra (target too low) on the monkey track while the growth miss scores on the rat track.

dose.note: Monkey and rat exposure was matched to daily rhGH per 5 days; no human dose, exposure target or margin stated in the abstract.
dose.quote: administration of MOD-4023 every 5 days in rats and monkeys resulted in exposure comparable to daily rhGH, and the serum half-life of MOD-4023 was significantly longer.
dose.confidence_note: Abstract only; the full text may state a human dose projection that was not checked.
dose.reason: No human dose or margin stated
dose.judgement: An animal-to-animal exposure comparison is not a human dose prediction; children later needed 0.66 mg/kg/wk (Zelinska 2017), but no monkey target to score it against.
dose.model: Rhesus monkey PK/PD and repeat-dose toxicology (somatrogon)

efficacy.note: Somatrogon every 4-5 days matched daily hGH weight gain in hypophysectomized rats.
efficacy.short: Rat weight gain matched daily hGH
efficacy.quote: These data establish a rationale for using this chimera as a long-acting GH analog.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry; the rat track also covers somavaratan (Cleland 2012: threefold more potent than daily rhGH in hypophysectomized rats).

efficacy.magnitude_basis: height velocity on drug vs untreated GHD
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PMC full text not retrievable). No daily-GH arm, so growth was judged against untreated expectation. Registry record not looked up.
efficacy.note: VISTA: somavaratan weekly, twice-monthly or monthly gave 7.6-8.6 cm/y height velocity in GHD children, as rats predicted growth.
efficacy.quote: Somavaratan demonstrated clinically meaningful improvements in HV and IGF-1 in prepubertal children with GHD, with no significant differences between monthly, twice-monthly, or weekly dosing.
efficacy.judgement: Paired by me with Cleland 2012 (rat: threefold more potent than daily rhGH). Growth occurred, so same in direction; the potency claim was untested here.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: height velocity vs daily rhGH (rat: 3x more potent; children: inferior)
efficacy.confidence_note: Press release (tier 5); registry NCT02339090 results posted 2022-12-30 confirm (9.43 vs 10.70 cm/y; CI lower bound -2.32 vs margin -2.0). Somatrogon later met non-inferiority, which does not undo this.
efficacy.note: VELOCITY: somavaratan failed non-inferiority to daily rhGH for height velocity, though rats rated it threefold more potent.
efficacy.quote: Non-inferiority versus daily growth hormone was not demonstrated in the intent to treat (ITT) population for the primary efficacy variable
efficacy.judgement: One drug's contra beats another's same: somatrogon's non-inferiority (Deal 2022; NCT02968004) is listed in patient_trials and does not turn the track back. Somatrogon's adult trial (NCT01909479) missed trunk fat, a readout no model predicted.

patient_trials.quote: The efficacy of once-weekly somatrogon was noninferior to once-daily somatropin, with similar safety and tolerability profiles.
There was no significant difference between somatrogon and placebo in change in trunk FM from baseline to Week 26 (-0.37 vs 0.03 kg; p=0.0821; primary endpoint) or in total FM.

safety.note: Somavaratan caused no lipoatrophy in pigs or monkeys, the harm that stopped earlier pegylated GH.
safety.quote: VRS-317 also did not cause lipoatrophy in pig and monkey studies.
safety.judgement: A stated negative prediction on a harm these species can show (local lipolysis at the injection site).

safety.confidence_note: PMC full text. Single doses only; repeat-dose pediatric data (Moore 2016) not read in full.
safety.note: No injection-site lipoatrophy in 40 GHD adults on somavaratan over 60 days of follow-up.
safety.quote: There were no instances of injection site lipoatrophy or hypersensitivity reported throughout 60 days of posttreatment observation.
safety.judgement: Paired by me. Single-dose exposure is a weak test of a cumulative local harm; confidence medium.

safety.note: Repeat-dose toxicology called somatrogon well tolerated in rats and monkeys; no harm named. Pediatric lipoatrophy case reports followed in 2025.
safety.quote: MOD-4023 was found to be well-tolerated in rats and monkeys, with minimal adverse events, suggesting an acceptable safety profile.
safety.confidence_note: Abstract only; whether the monkey studies examined injection-site lipoatrophy is not known. Toxicology detail and FDA/EMA nonclinical reviews not checked.
safety.judgement: A general tolerability statement names no harm, so no_prediction. The 2025 lipoatrophy case series (3 GHD children, no denominator; rhGH also causes it) is not scored as a contra of a silence that is unpublished in detail.
safety.model: Rhesus monkey PK/PD and repeat-dose toxicology (somatrogon)
